item.title: Hargreaves Lansdown shakes up fees in biggest change in 10 years – what does it mean for you?
item.description: Hargreaves Lansdown is lowering its headline fee from 0.45% to 0.35% – but not everyone will be happy with the new fee structure, it’s been suggested.

item.title: NS&I cuts interest rates on two easy-access savings accounts – are they still worth it?
item.description: NS&I is to make further rate cuts on its savings accounts, just weeks after launching less attractive rates on fixed-term British Savings Bonds

item.title: Ground rents to be capped at £250 a year – what does it mean for you?
item.description: The government has published draft legislation which would see ground rents capped at £250 per year for leaseholders. We examine what it means for homeowners and the housing market.

item.title: ‘Sandwich generation’ carers losing £6,000 a year to support elderly relatives
item.description: Middle-aged adults are often caught between caring for children or grandchildren and their elderly parents, leaving them taking time out of the workforce and facing a huge hit to wages while they are still trying to save for retirement. We look at the true cost of caring.

item.title: The UK areas which saw biggest jump in asking prices in 2025 – is yours on the list?
item.description: We look at the UK areas where asking prices rose the most last year.

item.title: HMRC stamp duty crackdown sees probes of property deals jump 88% – what to watch out for
item.description: From bogus stamp duty refund claims to misleading the taxman about who owns a property, HMRC is increasing its scrutiny of stamp duty land tax reporting. Here’s how.

item.title: Lifetime ISA reform: Retirement option could be scrapped in overhaul
item.description: A consultation on a product replacing the Lifetime ISA is set to be launched this year, and the option to use it to save for retirement is expected to be axed in the shake-up

item.title: UK dividends rose in final quarter of 2025, but share buybacks ate into investor payouts
item.description: Last year saw dividend growth continue to fall below pre-pandemic averages, against a backdrop of increasing share buybacks.

item.title: Premium Bonds quiz: How much do you know about the NS&I savings product?
item.description: Many savers choose Premium Bonds in the hopes of winning a prize in the monthly draws. How much do you know about the savings product?

item.title: London house prices: Is the capital's property boom over?
item.description: Buyers and investors have always been drawn towards the capital’s property market. But as house prices stall, is the market as lucrative as it once was and are buyers and investors still interested?
